correctness.rationale: Since every vertex is in an edge and G is bipartite, the signed stable-set polytope equals {|x_a|+|x_b|<=1 : ab edge}. Independent coordinate sign reflections force unique John ellipsoid diagonal centered at 0. Squared semiaxes u optimize strictly concave sum log u_v under all edge sums u_a+u_b<=1. Candidate u_core=1/(p+1), u_leaf=p/(p+1) has every leaf sum 1 and every core sum<=1. Positive dual multipliers lambda_leaf=(p+1)/p solve leaf/core gradients exactly; concavity supporting hyperplanes prove GLOBAL unique optimum for arbitrary core edges. Core facet support sqrt(1/(p_i+1)+1/(p_j+1)) equals 1 iff both p_i=p_j=1, else <=sqrt(5/6), producing stated clearance /sqrt(2) and 4 signed facets per edge. Product semiaxes gives volume; claims checked against edge facet irredundancy. Independent exact rational enumeration of all bipartite core-edge subsets r<=5, p_i in {1,2,3}, gave 49,365 core-edge dual/feasibility checks; finite corroboration, not proof beyond formula.
